job.job_description:
We have an urgent job opening for our client Tech Mahindra.


Locations: Noida/ Pune/ Mumbai/ Bangalore/ Hyderabad/ Chennai



AI Engineer: 

Design, develop, and deploy AI agents, copilots, and enterprise automation solutions using Python and modern AI technologies.
Build agentic AI workflows using frameworks such as Semantic Kernel, LangGraph, LangChain, Langfuse, CrewAI, Azure AI Agent Service, or equivalent technologies.
Develop and integrate solutions leveraging Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Foundry, AI Services, enterprise APIs, and business applications.
Build secure, scalable, and production-grade AI services following enterprise architecture and governance standards.
Integrate enterprise knowledge sources, search platforms, databases, and line-of-business systems.
Implement monitoring, observability, evaluation, performance optimization, and AI solution lifecycle management.
Deploy and manage AI workloads using Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD pipelines, and cloud-native architectures.
Strong experience in Python, Azure AI Services, REST APIs, GitHub, DevOps practices, enterprise integrations, and distributed application development.
